_comment: Non-secret defaults. Secrets (API keys) are NEVER stored here: use the Settings UI (encrypted local store) or environment variables / .env.

iex.name: IEX
iex.note: The IEX exchange trades 08:00–09:30 (pre-market), 09:30–16:00 (regular) and 16:00–17:00 ET (post-market). The free Alpaca IEX feed carries no prints or quote changes outside those hours; on early-close days post-market is assumed to end 60 minutes after the close.

overnight._comment: Overnight session 20:00-04:00 ET (Sunday-Thursday nights, NYSE holiday calendar). provider: auto (Alpaca overnight, else Tiingo) | alpaca | tiingo | none. alpacaFeed: overnight (free: real-time INDICATIVE quotes, 15-min DELAYED trades) | boats (Blue Ocean ATS, Algo Trader Plus). Overnight prices are monitoring data; simulated execution needs execution.overnight AND execution-grade quotes.

tiingo._comment: Tiingo 24x5 consolidated reference price (derived data, not trades/quotes). Free Starter plan: 50 requests/hour — one request covers all symbols.

ai._comment: usageMode = ECONOMY | BALANCED | DETAILED (how often the AI may be asked; risk protections are identical). mode = DEEPSEEK | GEMINI | AUTO | DUAL (which provider analyses; see server/ai/providerManager.js). provider is the pre-mode setting, kept only to migrate older configurations.

pricing._comment: USD per 1M tokens from https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing (checked 2026-11-19). Peak = 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri; all other hours off-peak. Verify before relying on cost estimates.

models._geminiComment: Gemini Standard paid prices (USD / 1M tokens) from aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, read 2026-11-20. Output includes thinking tokens. The cached-input price was not confirmed, so cached tokens are costed at the full input price (an upper bound). Free-tier usage may cost nothing; verify before relying on estimates.

risk._comment: profile = CONSERVATIVE | BALANCED | AGGRESSIVE | VERY_AGGRESSIVE | CUSTOM (see server/trading/riskProfiles.js). The values below are the BALANCED preset. Simulation presets only, not investment advice.

adaptiveMonitoring._comment: Monitoring intensity by US session (America/New_York exchange calendar) and volatility. Higher intensity = more LOCAL monitoring; AI requests stay under every existing limit plus the ai.* caps here. It never changes risk limits and never starts AI trading. noNewEntriesLastMin: no NEW paper entries in the last minutes before the close (0 = off); positions are never liquidated by this feature. followerCandleClose: ask the AI on every analysis candle of watchlist symbols too (more requests).

ui._comment: language = ar (default, right-to-left) | en. Also sets the language of AI explanations.

telegram._comment: Bot token is a credential (encrypted store). Sensitive commands need the sender's Telegram user id in authorizedUserIds (a private chat id equals the user id).

sharia._comment: AAOIFI-style screen (30% debt, 30% deposits, 5% impermissible income). Information only: it never blocks or drives a decision.

retention._comment: High-volume tables only. Fills, orders, decisions, sessions and AI usage are never pruned.
